title: One client. <piv>The whole picture.</piv>
lead: You shouldn't have to remember where client information lives. Open a client and it's all there — in context.

train.title: The plan, and what actually happened.
train.body: See the programme you wrote next to every logged set, rep and weight — and how their strength is moving.

fuel.title: Macros, meals and the swaps you approved.
fuel.body: Their targets, meals and the alternatives you allowed — so food questions stop living in chat.

body.title: Measurements and photos, on one timeline.
body.body: Weight, 14 body measurements and progress photos — dated, comparable, and always with the client.

talk.title: Check-ins, notes and messages — in context.
talk.body: Read the check-in with their numbers beside it, reply in the same place, and keep private coach notes nobody else sees.
